title: Weight-space programming and mechanistic interpretability for model editing in particle physics
abstract: arXiv:2611.27079v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We demonstrate that weight-space programming and edits guided by sparse autoencoders can remove unwanted aspects of a particle-physics foundation model through direct edits to its weights. In a foundation model trained on jets, we observe that adding a single soft neutral particle causes large changes in jet classification, violating infrared safety. We locate the responsible attention heads with mechanistic analysis and trace the flaw's origin to pretraining on datasets with different reconstruction thresholds. We then propose two targeted approaches to repair the flaw: by removing three latent directions identified with sparse autoencoders, and by letting language-model agents edit the weights directly, without gradients and with only 50 queries to the model. translated_title: 粒子物理中模型编辑的权重空间编程与机制可解释性
translated_abstract: 我们证明，权重空间编程以及由稀疏自编码器引导的编辑，可以通过直接修改权重来消除粒子物理基础模型中不理想的特性。在一个在喷注数据上训练的基础模型中，我们观察到添加单个软中性粒子会导致喷注分类的巨大变化，违反了红外安全性。我们通过机制分析定位了负责该问题的注意力头，并将该缺陷的起源追溯到预训练数据集中不同的重建阈值。随后我们提出了两种针对性的修复方法：一是移除通过稀疏自编码器识别出的三个潜在方向；二是让语言模型智能体直接编辑权重，无需梯度计算，且仅需对模型进行50次查询。两种方法的编辑各自都能消除几乎整个缺陷，同时使模型其余部分的响应几乎保持不变。与微调相比，这两种方法改变的参数要少得多。
tldr: 该论文通过稀疏自编码器识别潜在方向的移除和语言模型智能体的免梯度权重编辑两种方法，成功修复了粒子物理基础模型中因预训练数据问题导致的违反红外安全性缺陷，且对模型其余功能几乎无影响，所需修改的参数远少于微调。
en_tdlr: This paper repairs an infrared-safety flaw in a particle-physics foundation model using two targeted weight-editing methods—removing latent directions identified by sparse autoencoders and gradient-free edits by language-model agents with only 50 model queries—nearly eliminating the flaw while leaving the rest of the model's behavior unchanged and modifying far fewer parameters than fine-tuning.
